entries.title: James 4:1
segments: ¶Where do wars and fights [come] from among you? Do [they] not [come] from your [desires for] pleasure that war in your members?

entries.title: James 4:2
segments: You lust and do not have. You murder and covet and cannot obtain. You fight and war. Yet you do not have because you do not ask.

entries.title: James 4:3
segments: You ask and do not receive, because you ask amiss, that you may spend [it] on your pleasures.

entries.title: James 4:4
segments: Adulterers and adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

entries.title: James 4:5
segments: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, "The Spirit who dwells in us yearns jealously"?

entries.title: James 4:6
segments: But He gives more grace. Therefore He says: "God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble."

entries.title: James 4:7
segments: Therefore submit to God. Resist the devil and he will flee from you.

entries.title: James 4:8
segments: Draw near to God and He will draw near to you. Cleanse [your] hands, [you] sinners; and purify [your] hearts, [you] double-minded.

entries.title: James 4:9
segments: Lament and mourn and weep! Let your laughter be turned to mourning and [your] joy to gloom.

entries.title: James 4:10
segments: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and He will lift you up.

entries.title: James 4:11
segments: ¶Do not speak evil of one another, brethren. He who speaks evil of a brother and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

entries.title: James 4:12
segments: There is one Lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. Who are you to judge another?

entries.title: James 4:13
segments: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to such and such a city, spend a year there, buy and sell, and make a profit";

entries.title: James 4:14
segments: whereas you do not know what [will happen] tomorrow. For what [is] your life? It is even a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

entries.title: James 4:15
segments: Instead you [ought] to say, "If the Lord wills, we shall live and do this or that."

entries.title: James 4:16
segments: But now you boast in your arrogance. All such boasting is evil.

entries.title: James 4:17
segments: Therefore, to him who knows to do good and does not do [it], to him it is sin.
